name: Veddige - Nösslinge

estimatedTime.note: No official section-specific hiking time found. The official Hallandsleden page and API provide distance and difficulty only. At Hallandsleden's general planning pace of about 4 km/hour, 28 km implies about 7 hours moving time, but this is not an official value and the red/hard grading reflects length, steep slopes, wet/stony paths and mixed road/forest trail.

difficulty.source: Hallandsleden section page and official API degree_of_difficulty=hard
difficulty.notes: Official copy describes a long section with steep slopes and paths that can be wet and stony, while also including easier road stretches. Field reports on the older Dranstugan-Gällarpesjön core support wet and routefinding-prone conditions but predate the 2024 reroute south of Veddige.

notes: Official order is Veddige to Nösslinge.

The practical GPX endpoint is at the Gällarpesjön/Gällarp stop and parking area, while the official section title uses Nösslinge. Nösslinge church and water are about 0.85-0.9 km east of the GPX endpoint.
No ferry, rowboat, required bus-transfer segment, official loop, or official alternate was found for the current N5 section.
The section links N4 at Veddige to N6 at Gällarpesjön/Nösslinge; official GPX endpoints stitch to adjacent N4/N6 within a few meters.

Older Naturkartan/OSM/user sources split this corridor as Dranstugan - Gällarpesjön or preserve Stättared - Dranstugan framing. Treat those as partial-overlap or stale subdivision context, not as current full N5 identity.

protectedAreas.name: Stora Neden-Mäsen water protection area
protectedAreas.relevance: Rules/safety lane found the checked official N5 GPX intersects the broader water-protection area near the Gällarpesjön/Nösslinge end.
rules: The water-protection area is intended to protect drinking-water supply.
Regulations restrict activities that risk polluting ground or surface water, including waste deposits, petroleum products, pesticides, manure handling and hazardous goods transport.
protectedAreas.confidence: high for regulatory source; medium for route-overlay precision
protectedAreas.importGuidance: Import a hiker-facing water-protection advisory: protect water, pack out waste, avoid contaminating streams/lakes, and obey posted water-protection signs. Do not overload hikers with industrial/agricultural permit rules.

rules: Nearby reserve visitor rules include no fires, no damage to trees/bushes, restrictions on mosses/lichens/fungi, no motor vehicles, no marking/signage, and no entry in a marked area from 1 April to 15 August.
protectedAreas.confidence: high for nearby reserve rules; medium-high that it is off current N5
protectedAreas.importGuidance: Do not apply Lapparetorpet restrictions to the whole N5 section. Add only as nearby protected-area caution if product shows side trips around Nösslinge/Furesjön.

protectedAreas.name: Nearby/continuation protected areas

protectedAreas.importGuidance: Keep for N6/N7 and side-trip context.

dogsAndLivestock: Hallandsleden says dogs should be leashed on the trail.
Dogs must be leashed or under strict supervision from 1 March to 20 August and in pastures with grazing livestock; dogs with strong hunting instinct should always be leashed.

hunting.seasonalWindow: General caution for August-January hunting season; elk hunting in Halland commonly starts 8 October and can run to 31 January in registered elk-hunting areas, but dates must be checked for the specific year.
guidance: Avoid the most intensive elk-hunting period at the beginning of October when possible.
hunting.importGuidance: Import as seasonal safety note, not as a closure.

terrainSafety: Official difficulty text says N5 is long and hard/red, with steep slopes and paths that can be wet and stony, while also including some road walking.

Older direct reports on the Dranstugan-Gällarpesjön core describe soaked footwear after rain, wet grass/small forest paths, routefinding ambiguity, and a slippery bridge, but these reports predate the 2024 reroute and should be caveated.
No N5-specific official bridge/flood closure was found on 2026-04-29. A bridge-related caution appears in nearby Gällarpesjön-Åkulla/N6 context and should not be imported to N5 without confirmation.
currentness: Official 2024 reroute south of Veddige is confirmed; use current digital route/GPX and treat June 2022 paper maps as stale.
No active N5-specific temporary closure was found in checked official/static sources on 2026-04-29, but do not import a fixed all-clear.
Fire-ban and fire-risk status must be checked dynamically via Brandrisk Ute, Länsstyrelsen/Krisinformation, Varberg municipality and/or Räddningstjänsten Väst.
Protected-area rules are stable enough to import as dated regulatory facts, but boundaries and newly formed reserves should be refreshed from Naturvårdsregistret/Länsstyrelsen during data updates.
